items.name: Entered
items.summary: A guard representing a span which has been entered and is currently executing.

items.name: EnteredSpan
items.summary: An owned version of [`Entered`], a guard representing a span which has been entered and is currently executing.

methods.name: exit
methods.summary: Exits this span, returning the underlying [`Span`].

methods.name: id
methods.summary: Returns this span's `Id`, if it is enabled.

items.name: Span
items.summary: A handle representing a span, with the capability to enter the span if it exists.

methods.name: child_of
methods.signature: fn child_of(parent: impl Into<Option<Id>>, meta: &'static Metadata<'static>, values: &field::ValueSet<'_>) -> Span
methods.summary: Constructs a new `Span` as child of the given parent span, with the given [metadata] and set of [field values].

methods.name: current
methods.summary: Returns a handle to the span [considered by the `Subscriber`] to be the current span.

methods.name: enter
methods.summary: Enters this span, returning a guard that will exit the span when dropped.

methods.name: entered
methods.summary: Enters this span, consuming it and returning a [guard][`EnteredSpan`] that will exit the span when dropped.

methods.name: field
methods.summary: Returns a [`Field`][super::field::Field] for the field with the given `name`, if one exists,

methods.name: follows_from
methods.summary: Indicates that the span with the given ID has an indirect causal relationship with this span.

methods.name: has_field
methods.summary: Returns true if this `Span` has a field for the given [`Field`][super::field::Field] or field name.

methods.name: id
methods.summary: Returns this span's `Id`, if it is enabled.

methods.name: in_scope
methods.signature: fn in_scope<F: FnOnce() -> T, T>(&self, f: F) -> T
methods.summary: Executes the given function in the context of this span.

methods.name: is_disabled
methods.summary: Returns `true` if this span was disabled by the subscriber and does not exist.

methods.name: is_none
methods.summary: Returns `true` if this span was constructed by [`Span::none`] and is empty.

methods.name: metadata
methods.summary: Returns this span's `Metadata`, if it is enabled.

methods.name: new
methods.summary: Constructs a new `Span` with the given [metadata] and set of [field values].

methods.name: new_disabled
methods.summary: Constructs a new disabled span with the given `Metadata`.

methods.name: new_root
methods.summary: Constructs a new `Span` as the root of its own trace tree, with the given [metadata] and set of [field values].

methods.name: none
methods.summary: Constructs a new span that is *completely disabled*.

methods.name: or_current
methods.summary: Returns this span, if it was [enabled] by the current [`Subscriber`], or the [current span] (whose lexical distance may be further than expected),  if this span [is disabled].

methods.name: record
methods.signature: fn record<Q: field::AsField + ?Sized, V: field::Value>(&self, field: &Q, value: V) -> &Self
methods.summary: Records that the field described by `field` has the value `value`.

methods.name: with_subscriber
methods.signature: fn with_subscriber<T>(&self, f: impl FnOnce((&Id, &Dispatch)) -> T) -> Option<T>
methods.summary: Invokes a function with a reference to this span's ID and subscriber.

items.name: AsId
items.summary: Trait implemented by types which have a span `Id`.

methods.name: as_id
methods.summary: Returns the `Id` of the span that `self` corresponds to, or `None` if this corresponds to a disabled span.
